WS-3/C:/SESSION/1839 61
Rejection of food consignments
*201. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that United States
and European Union have rejected large
consignments of Indian food products;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action being taken by
Government in this regard?
SC's observations on the
Representation of the People Act
*202. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
SHRI N. K.  PREMACHANDRAN:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some time
back the Supreme Court of India has
declared Section 33-B of the Representation
of the People Act as unconstitutional;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have submitted/
decided to submit a review petition in the
matter to the court;
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(e) the other steps being taken to hasten
the process of electoral reforms?
Employment in projects of foreign
companies
†*203. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the foreign
companies implementing their construction
projects in the country are to employ local
experts and skilled workers;
(b) whether foreign experts and skilled
workmen are brought from abroad as per
the conditions laid down by the World Trade
Organisation whereas there is no dearth of
experts and skilled workmen in the country;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

62
WS-3/C:/SESSION/1977RS 62
Pilferage of medicines
†*204. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that medicines
supplied for different hospitals were seized
during a raid conducted on the 9th June,
2003 by the Drugs Control Department,
Delhi and the Bureau of Economic
Offences;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of employees of hospitals
and chemists involved in this racket and the
hospitals to which they belong to;
(d) the action taken by Government
against the culprits; and
(e) the arrangements made by
Government to check recurrence of such
incidents in future?
Health for all by 2000
*205. SHRIMATI  SHABANA AZMI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had a plan for
Health for All by 2000;
(b) the extent to which Government have
implemented the plan so far;
(c) whether it is a fact that despite the
plan 1000 Indians die every day of
tuberculosis and other diseases; if so, the
reasons therefor;
(d) the amount provided to the States in
achieving this plan and the steps taken to
implement this plan so far;
(e) whether there is continuous shortage
of doctors and nurses in the country; and
(f) if so, the extent of shortage of doctors
at present and the steps Government propose
to take to improve the position?
Broadcasting Policy
*206. DR. A.R. KIDWAI:
SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMAD
KHAN (DURRU):
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to formulate a comprehensive Broadcasting
Policy in view of the massive expansion of
satellite television and private FM radio;
(b) whether a meeting was convened by
his Ministry recently with the broadcasters
to know their views;
(c) if so, whether the draft policy
prepared by his Ministry was also discussed;
(d) if so, the views expressed by the
broadcasters; and
(e) by when the Broadcasting Policy is
likely to be announced?
Conversion of residential property
*207. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
DR. AKHILESH DAS:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to restart the scheme for converting the
residential property from leasehold to
freehold in the capital;
(b) if so, the details of the scheme
especially with respect to sub-leasees of
DDA plots and flats, held through the
cooperative housing societies; and
(c) the number of applications received
and those disposed so far?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Setting up of Trade Advisory Board
†1487. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to set up a Trade Advisory
Board for effective solutions in trade and
for setting up a separate internal
department for promotion of trade;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the progress made in this regard,
so far?
Export of value added items
†1488. SHRI  KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
 Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the export
of the value added items based on the
labour cost is in the interest of the country;
(b) if not Government's reaction
thereto; and
(c) the average percentage of the
exports of the value added items based
on labour cost made from the country
during the last three years against the
yearly exports?
Import of raw materials
†1489. SHRI  RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL :
 Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that import of
the raw materials has been more than
export of the finished products in terms
of value;
(b) if so, the respective values of the
imported raw materials and the exports
of the finished products during the years
2000-01, 2001-02 and 2002-03; and
(c) the prevailing condition of the
foreign trade due to the higher value of
the imports against the exports?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

WIN2\SESSION\1979RS 327
Services for foreign investment
1490. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
DR. AKHILESH DAS:
 Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether as agreed at the Doha
meeting of the World Trade Organisation
India has freed seven lucrative services
including IT for foreign investment;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have
requested for reciprocal action from its
key trading partners;
(d) if so, the details of the trading
partners and the reciprocal action taken
by them; and
(e) how far this has helped to promote
India's interest in liberalisation of
movement of IT professionals across the
borders and helping Indian companies to
sell their services abroad electronically and
increasing Indian commercial presence
abroad by opening more branches and
subsidiaries abroad, especially in respect
of US, EU and South East Asian countries?
Trade ties between India and UAE
1491. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MISS MABEL REBELLO:
 Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and the United Arab
Emirates have decided to start a strategic
dialogue and strengthen trade ties by
setting up a Joint Business Council;
(b) if so, whether this decision would
raise the level of relations between the two
countries;
(c) whether all the disputes between the
two countries would be settled as a result
thereof;
(d) if so, the issues involved between
the two countries; and
(e) to what extent, agreement has
reached after setting up of this Joint
Business Council?
Achievements of CII missions abroad
1492. SHRI   B.J. PANDA:
MISS MABEL REBELLO:
 Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) has
sent 20 missions abroad to create
awareness about the key business issues
and to grow trade and information and
bridge the institutional gaps etc.;
(b) if so, the countries where these
missions have gone, with success achieved
by them;
(c) whether a chamber delegation had
accompanied him to Mexico, US and the
other countries for the purpose; and
(d) if so, the countries visited and the
mutual agreements, if any, signed in the
export sector?
WTO ruling against India
1493. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the WTO has ruled against
India in a complaint involving country of
origin certificates for export of textiles/
apparels to US; and
(b) if so, its likely impact on Indian
textile/apparel exports to US in the
coming months?
